ruleDefinitions.name: Potential DLL Sideloading Using Coregen.exe
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect usage of the "coregen.exe" (Microsoft CoreCLR Native Image Generator) binary to sideload arbitrary DLLs. Note: Unmapped fields: ImageLoaded

sequences.query: process_path = RGX("\\\\coregen\\\.exe$") AND  NOT ((ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\Microsoft\\ Silverlight\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\Microsoft\\ Silverlight\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\") OR ImageLoaded = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\")))
